# Kairos.Artifex

> Strategy, Design and Engineering working as one. Kairos.Artifex is a premium creative development agency.

This file provides information about the services, disciplines, case studies, and contact details of Kairos.Artifex, optimized for LLMs and AI agents.

- [Home Page](https://kairosartifex.site/) - Main entry point of the portfolio containing hero section, interactive showcases, bio, and contact form.

- [llms-full.txt](https://kairosartifex.site/llms-full.txt) - The full, detailed knowledge base of Kairos.Artifex for AI models.

## Disciplines & Expertise
- Brand Strategy & Brand Identity
- UI/UX Design & Product Design
- Website Design & SaaS Design

- Three.js WebGL Experiences & Motion Design
- AI Integrations

## Case Studies
- [Aakar Concept Study](https://kairosartifex.site/work/aakar) - Premium logo and visual identity concept designed around craftsmanship, natural materials, and architectural elegance (2025).
- [Dhankamya Branding](https://kairosartifex.site/work/dhankamya) - Luxury jewelry brand identity design specializing in natural stone ornaments (2025).
- [Lorive Perfume Branding](https://kairosartifex.site/work/lorive) - Artisanal premium perfume brand identity built on restraint, calm color palettes, and floral symbolism (2025).
- [MechTech Infrasolutions](https://kairosartifex.site/work/mechtech) - Modern digital platform and interface design system for infrastructure and engineering (2026).
- [Dhankamya UI/UX](https://kairosartifex.site/work/dhankamya-uiux) - E-commerce landing page concept with minimal layout for handcrafted stone jewelry (2025).
- [Luxora Candle Branding](https://kairosartifex.site/work/luxora) - Premium aesthetic candle brand website design concept focusing on editorial layouts (2025).
